name: customergpt
description: AI-generated sales-objection roleplay, at scale. React + serverless rebuild.
comment-on-deps: Live serverless mode (npm run dev:live / deploy) also needs: openai, zod, @upstash/ratelimit, @upstash/redis, @vercel/node. They are intentionally NOT in dependencies so 'npm install && npm run dev' stays lean and replay-only. Add them when you wire live mode: npm i openai zod @upstash/ratelimit @upstash/redis && npm i -D @vercel/node
